description: Verify cainban MCP compatibility, update version, and deploy
context: Verified MCP server outputs strict JSON format. The server correctly outputs JSON-RPC 2.0 compliant responses to stdout, with only startup messages going to stderr. This is compatible with Q chat's strict JSON requirements.
Found issue: MCP server outputs "Starting MCP server..." to stderr which violates Q chat's strict JSON-only requirement. Need to remove this debug output.
